intro.text: A Rosharan plant used to make textiles.

description.text: Jah Keved grows breachtrees for textiles, and their cotton is traded as a commodity.
Breachtree cotton is spun into fabric, sometimes scratchy, that can be dyed and made into anything from coats to robes.

items.text: As a young man, Kaladin had a padded brown coat of breachtree cloth.
In 1170 Lin Davar had to sell breachtree cotton and raw shum to Revilar at a huge discount to gain influence with him.
In his fight with Kaladin in Urithiru, Zahel had on a worn tan robe of breachtree cotton, belted with a rope.
